dct_title_s: Ethiopia - Addis Ababa subcities and woredas
dct_description_sm: The dataset titled "Addis Ababa City Administration Woreda Boundary" provides detailed geographic information on the administrative divisions within Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. It includes shapefiles delineating the boundaries of both subcities and woredas (districts) within the city. Each feature in the dataset is attributed with identifiers and names corresponding to specific subcities and woredas, facilitating spatial analysis and mapping of Addis Ababa's administrative structure.​ This dataset is particularly useful for urban planning, resource allocation, and various analyses requiring precise administrative boundary data within Addis Ababa. Original source: [Addis Ababa City Administration Woreda Boundary ](https://data.moa.gov.et/dataset/addis-ababa-city-administration-woreda-boundary)
